item.title: Using Ext JS library with Webcenter Portal
item.description: Ext JS is a JavaScript library for building interactive web applications 11 using techniques such asAjax, DHTML and DOM scripting. It’s quite simple to integrate a Javascript code with webcenter. For instance, let’s consider this use case: get an XML document form a given URL, then display it at a fragment in an existing Webcenter Portal page in order to browse the content:.
